summary: Innovative Solutions and Support filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of Sparton Aydin, LLC (Aydin Displays) from Sparton Corporation for $24.5 million in cash, financed via its J.P. Morgan Chase credit facility. The purchase price is subject to customary working capital, indebtedness, and transaction expense adjustments. Aydin designs ruggedized displays for defense and commercial markets. The agreement includes a five-year non-compete for the seller in the U.S. and Canada, a transition services agreement, and a supply agreement. The filing discloses no board recommendation or advisor. The transaction closed concurrently and is classified as an acquisition. Watch for post-close integration and the impact of the supply agreement.
